scope: Plant-side only. The controller law, gas holding/tuck table (13db9ada...), PD gains, observation layout and action ABI are unchanged, so an exported actor stays drop-in for the RMCS wheelbipe deployment.

sim_mapping.feedback_delay_ticks: (feedback_age_ms + zoh_equivalent_ms) / physics_dt; applied to both PD position and PD velocity by linear interpolation of the per-tick history
sim_mapping.actuation_delay_ticks: actuation_delay_ms / physics_dt; applied torque is the per-step blend of the current and previous PD output
sim_mapping.velocity_filter: first-order EMA at the physics rate on the simulator joint velocity, tau_sim = velocity_filter_tau_ms + filter_tau_offset_ms
sim_mapping.basis: PhysX semi-implicit Euler Q/U = h^2 z / (J (z-1)^2) has no zero-order-hold lag, so the 2.5 ms hold is reinserted as feedback delay. At PD 80/1.5 and J 0.016-0.03 the mapped loop reproduces the continuous measured-timing model within 1.5 deg phase margin and 2 Hz phase crossover at nominal and at every range corner.

leg_feedback.policy_observation: Leg joint velocity uses the same DM-filtered stream delayed by feedback_age only and quantized; the v2 contract's uniform leg velocity noise is still added. Wheel velocity is unchanged.

gas_spring_plant.change: physical slider force only: the beta > 100 deg tail follows the measured 14.3/12.9 Nm holding torque at 102/108 deg instead of decaying to zero

leg_armature.basis: measured hip M_hh 0.078-0.083 (+/-3%); knee M_kk 0.013-0.020 not separable from damping; the nominal 0.015795 armature is retained until the mode 6 sweep separates M and D

randomization: Lanes selected nominal by the v2 contract keep every nominal value. Other lanes draw uniformly in range and are pulled toward nominal by --randomization-strength. Timing is gated by the profile's timing group; friction and armature by the lane and strength.
not_modelled: policy inference latency beyond the v2 0/1 frame age
